content.query:
SELECT 
    TABLE_SCHEMA,
    TABLE_NAME,
    COLUMN_NAME,
    DATA_TYPE,
        '(' + CAST(NUMERIC_PRECISION AS VARCHAR(10))
        + ',' +
        CAST(NUMERIC_SCALE AS VARCHAR(10))
        + ')' AS PrecisionScale
FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS
WHERE TABLE_NAME like '%TRY_FITRADES'
